description: PY-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Puducherry region, serving as the headquarters for vehicle registration and licensing in the Union Territory. It handles a wide range of services including issuance of driving licenses, vehicle fitness certificates, and tax collection for the Puducherry district.
address: 100 Feet Road, Olandaikeerapalayam, Opposite Bus Stand, Mudaliarpet, Puducherry - 605004

description: The PY-02 RTO serves the Karaikal district, one of the four enclaves of the Union Territory of Puducherry. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the local population and commercial fleet in the region.
address: Regional Transport Office, Civil Station, Karaikal, Puducherry

description: The PY-03 RTO serves the Mahe enclave of the Union Territory of Puducherry, located on the Malabar Coast of Kerala. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations for the geographically distinct Mahe district.
address: Regional Transport Office (RTO) Mahe, Transport Unit Office, Civil Station, Mahe, Puducherry

description: The PY-04 RTO is the official transport authority for the Yanam enclave, which is a distinct district of the Union Territory of Puducherry located near Andhra Pradesh. This office manages all statutory requirements under the Motor Vehicles Act, including vehicle registration and driving license issuance for the local population.
address: Transport Unit Office, Civil Station, Opposite to Regional Executive Office, Yanam, Puducherry

description: PY-05 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Oulgaret (Uzhavarkarai) region within the Puducherry district. It was created as a bifurcation from the main Puducherry RTO (PY-01) to handle the significant increase in vehicle registrations in the northern and western urban clusters. The office manages driver licensing, vehicle fitness certifications, and tax collection for its specific taluk.
address: Govt. Automobile Workshop (GAW) Building, Kamaraj Salai, Saram, Puducherry
